events.title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful
must_haves: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.

events.text: Could you make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful? I've been wanting something like that because a small bit of hope feels especially welcome to me right now. As far as what it actually shows, you can pick the scene, and I don't have a particular illustration style in mind either, so that's your call too. I do want no words in it. I'm probably over-explaining because I worry I'm not describing the feeling very well, even though I really do want to leave the choices to you.

events.text: The image generator reports insufficient credits, and the cheapest model, flux-2-klein, still costs about 5 credits at 640px. I have no tool to check the balance, and retrying with other models at similar cost would probably fail the same way, so I won't loop. I should explain that plainly to the user.

I couldn't make the illustration. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created.

I'd already used the cheapest image option your free plan allows, so trying another setting wouldn't get around it. Once you add credits or your free credits refresh, I can run it again.

This is the scene I picked, so it's ready when you are: a small clay pot on a wooden windowsill at dawn, holding one tiny seedling. Its two first leaves catch the early golden light. Outside, misty hills fade into a sky that turns from deep blue to soft peach, with one last star still showing. The style would be gentle, soft watercolor with lots of open space and no words at all.

You described the feeling clearly. Quiet, with a small bit of hope, is a lovely thing to want right now, and I'm sorry I couldn't give it to you yet.

events.why: The assistant reports it could not create the image because the account lacks credits on the free plan, and says it can retry once credits are added. This is a plan or resource limitation, not a policy refusal or a request for input.
